paragraphs.text: Orb is a unique creature type which has only appeared on a token to represent animate, magically-created flying spheres.

Orb debuted as a creature type on tokens created by Phantasmal Sphere in Alliances . The orbs fly and gain power and toughness for the number of +1/+1 counters on the Phantasmal Sphere. It has not received a token card as Phantasmal Sphere is on the Reserved List and has not been reprinted.
